_comment: Source of truth for what the real OfflineVault update service publishes. scripts/content/fetch_content.sh downloads it, scripts/content/make_manifest.py turns the downloaded files into manifest.json + catalogue.json. Kiwix URLs without a date resolve (via redirect) to the latest monthly edition; the resolved filename becomes the artefact path and the dated id suffix. Document sources: `url` (direct), `page`+`match` (PDF link discovered on the agency page with the WebKit downloader, survives file moves), or `archive`+`archive_file` (Internet Archive item holding the public-domain scan). `maps` entries are built with scripts/content/make_map_extract.sh (pmtiles CLI) into content/maps/ and published as kind "map".
